shots.line: Max thought he knew every hustle at Eastside High.
shots.scene: schoolLot wide, Max walks in from the left, Jay waves him over; camera drifts right with Max

shots.line: Then Jay told him about the kid selling tickets for a dollar.
shots.scene: medium two-shot, Jay hands on head wince + NO WAY bubble, soft green car in the foreground

shots.line: That night, Max dug out his old headphones.
shots.scene: garage at night, hanging bulb, Max lifts the orange headphones and looks at them, slow push

shots.line: The kid was his little brother, Leo.
shots.scene: medium: Leo behind the cardboard stand lifts the SHOW $1 sign, soft tree foreground

shots.line: And the line went all the way to the fence.
shots.scene: wide: queue of three kids (yellow afro, blue headband, purple bun with cash) facing the stand; camera slides along the line
giant close-up Leo, star eyes, $3 sticker slams in with a camera hit

shots.line: The show? A boxing match. Starring Max.
shots.scene: boxing gym, ring with ropes in front, Max in blue gloves vs rival in red headgear, ROUND 1 label pops

shots.line: They split the money on the way home.
shots.scene: tracking walk through the underground car park, Leo with the sign, Max beside him, B3 pillar wipes past

shots.line: Would you pay a dollar to see it?
shots.scene: end screen: question, subscribe pill, whole cast lined up on grass
